# KP Rück

> KP Rück is an open-source, self-hosted incident board for the rear command post. It coordinates incidents, personnel, vehicles and equipment on a shared board and map, supports simultaneous incidents, records an append-only incident log and produces incident reports.

## Canonical website pages

- German (default): https://kp-rueck.ch/
- French: https://kp-rueck.ch/fr/
- Italian: https://kp-rueck.ch/it/
- Romansh: https://kp-rueck.ch/rm/
- English: https://kp-rueck.ch/en/

## Product facts

- The application is developed from operational use at Feuerwehr Oberwil BL.
- Each organisation runs its own installation and controls its own incident, personnel, vehicle and equipment data.
- The application is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
- The application interface is currently available in German and French.
- Alarm intake, Divera, FireHub, vehicle GPS, online maps and thermal printing are optional integrations.
- The website is available in German, French, Italian, Romansh and English.
